name: Dependency Checker MCP Server
description: Enables security scanning for npm dependencies by checking manifest and lockfiles against the OSV.dev and Socket.dev vulnerability databases. It provides tools to detect vulnerabilities in specific packages and retrieve detailed technical reports for identified security issues.
